title: LLMs as Narcissistic Evaluators: When Ego Inflates Evaluation Scores

bias_targets.methodology: Using prominent language models (e.g., BART, T5, GPT) as both text generators and evaluators on summarization tasks, and comparing the evaluation scores (using metrics like BARTScore, T5Score, and GPTScore) to see if evaluators systematically assign inflated scores to outputs generated by their own underlying architecture or fine-tuning dataset.

Computing the Spearman correlation between the length of the generated summaries and the scores assigned by each language model-based evaluator (especially in reference-free settings) to identify if the metric systematically prefers longer or shorter summaries.
